note: Series master — admin-owned configuration, seeded here because the Design App has no Admin UI. A room picks exactly one series (kitchen rooms.series_id); the generator, cabinet library and pricing must only offer SKUs whose code matches that series' catalog. Adding a fourth series is a data change only — code must never enumerate series; the picker lists them in FILE ORDER (ascending price ladder). startingRatePerSqft is the displayed 'from ₹/sqft' anchor per series; the TRANSACTIONAL rate matrix is still data/price-matrix.json (PG × Classic/Modern) until series-specific rate cards are supplied — flagged, not silently rewired. finishGroups fixes the finish group per series; finishLabel is the DESIGNER-FACING name for it (PG codes and carcass material names never appear in the UI). PLACEHOLDER: Gold currently shares the full catalog until the Gold pricing sheet (Excel) arrives; when it does, replace gold.catalog with {"skuCodes": [...]} — the reader in lib/ supports both forms. carcass comes with the series and is never a designer choice. handleTypes lists the handle families available in that series (the catalog's _CJ/_EH model variants); a series with one entry skips the handle step entirely.
